tips.text: KoboldCpp bundles a full KoboldAI Lite web UI, single-file zero-install distribution, and built-in image generation and speech-to-text -- none of which come with bare llama.cpp.
AUTOMATIC1111, the most-used Stable Diffusion web UI, first launched on August 22, 2022 and is licensed under AGPL-3.0.
ExLlamaV2's EXL2 quantization format mixes 2-bit to 8-bit precision per layer to hit a target average bitrate, instead of one fixed bit-width across the whole model.
llama.cpp defined the GGUF (.gguf) model file format now used across most of the local-LLM ecosystem.
LoRAX started as a fork of Hugging Face's text-generation-inference, then added dynamic multi-LoRA adapter loading on top of it.
AutoGPT is really two differently-licensed projects sharing one repo: the MIT-licensed classic CLI agent, and a separately-licensed hosted Platform product.
NVIDIA Dynamo ships many model- and platform-specific release tags at a fast cadence, rather than one single version number for the whole project.
little-coder defaults to a locally served Qwen3.6-35B-A3B model running over llama.cpp, tuned specifically to get good results from smaller local models.
